response.sql:
WITH station_counts AS (
    SELECT
        o.observstation,
        COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
    FROM observatories AS o
    LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
        ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.observstation
), shares AS (
    SELECT
        observstation,
        telescope_count,
        1.0 * telescope_count / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share
    FROM station_counts
), scored AS (
    SELECT
        observstation,
        telescope_count,
        share,
        share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS above_average
    FROM shares
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, above_average
FROM scored
WHERE above_average > 0
ORDER BY above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted mean across every observatory station, including stations with zero telescopes; each station’s share uses the total telescope count across all stations.
